extension.summary: Coworking price index for a city
extension.description: Choose a city and see the current CoworkingView Price Index: median flexible-desk, fixed-desk, private-office and related prices, with the sample size and the CC BY 4.0 attribution. Figures are read from the public CoworkingView API. There is no account and no tracking.
extension.disclaimer: Prices are medians from the CoworkingView Price Index and are licensed CC BY 4.0. A small sample is marked as low confidence. This add-on does not sell offices, show advertising, or ask you to sign in.
extension.news: v1.0.0 (2026-11-03)[CR]- First release. Choose a city and view its CoworkingView Price Index.
